approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an 8-second vertical 9:16 event promo for LANTERN NIGHT. Cinematic nighttime park with many warm amber glowing paper lanterns suspended among trees and lining a footpath, dark navy sky, gentle atmospheric haze, beautiful golden bokeh, inviting magical community evening. One continuous shot with a very slow forward camera glide, gently swaying lanterns, stable composition. Design as a polished readable event poster in motion: keep the center dark and uncluttered behind large crisp high-contrast ivory typography. Exact on-screen text only, spelled exactly: top heading 'LANTERN NIGHT'; large central date '14 NOVEMBER 2026'; large venue beneath it on two lines 'WILLOW PARK' and 'BRISTOL'. Date and venue must be prominent, readable on a phone, fully inside generous safe margins and held stationary and clearly visible for the entire eight seconds. No extra text, no invented time, no logos, no watermark-like graphics. Warm lantern glow subtly illuminates the edges without obscuring the words. No speech, no voiceover, no music, silent video.
